import Spec
import I5hLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result oxicloud_kernel oxicloud_kernel.Spec I5hLib

namespace oxicloud_kernel.Solution

def HasLiveOwner (db : model.Db) (now : I64) : Prop :=
  ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now

theorem index_mem {α : Type} (v : alloc.vec.Vec α) (i : Usize) (g : α)
    (h : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice α) v i = ok g) :
    g ∈ v.val := by
  simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index, alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize] at h
  split at h
  · simp at h
  · rename_i x hx
    simp only [ok.injEq] at h
    subst x
    exact List.mem_of_getElem? hx

theorem increment_val (i j : Usize) (h : i + 1#usize = ok j) :
    j.val = i.val + 1 := by
  have hs := UScalar.add_equiv i (1#usize)
  simp only [h] at hs
  exact hs.2.1

theorem role_implies_share (role : model.Role) :
    acl.role_implies role .Share = ok (decide (role = .Owner)) := by
  cases role <;> simp [acl.role_implies,
    model.Role.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqRole.eq, model.Role.read_discriminant]

theorem live_eq (g : model.Grant) (now : I64) :
    acl.live g now = ok (Spec.live g now) := by
  unfold acl.live Spec.live
  cases g.expires_at <;> rfl

theorem grant_progress (db : model.Db) (i j : Usize)
    (hlt : i < db.grants.len) (h : i + 1#usize = ok j) :
    db.grants.val.length - j.val < db.grants.val.length - i.val := by
  have := increment_val i j h
  scalar_tac

theorem direct_owner (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64)
    (r : model.Resource) (now : I64) (i : Usize) (result : Bool)
    (h : acl.direct_grant_exists_loop db types ids .Share r now i = ok result) :
    result = true → HasLiveOwner db now := by
  unfold acl.direct_grant_exists_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun _ => True) (fun b => b = true → HasLiveOwner db now)
    (fun j => db.grants.val.length - j.val) ?_ i result trivial h
  intro j out _ hs
  unfold acl.direct_grant_exists_loop.body at hs
  i5h_invert hs
  all_goals simp_all only [role_implies_share, live_eq, ok.injEq, decide_eq_true_eq]
  all_goals first
    | (intro _; exact ⟨_, index_mem _ _ _ (by assumption), by assumption, by assumption⟩)
    | exact ⟨trivial, grant_progress db j _ (by assumption) (by assumption)⟩
    | simp

theorem direct_exists_owner (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64)
    (r : model.Resource) (now : I64)
    (h : acl.direct_grant_exists db types ids .Share r now = ok true) :
    HasLiveOwner db now := by
  exact direct_owner db types ids r now 0#usize true h rfl

theorem folder_owner (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64)
    (target : alloc.vec.Vec U64) (now : I64) (i : Usize) (result : Bool)
    (h : acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop db types ids .Share now target i = ok result) :
    result = true → HasLiveOwner db now := by
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun _ => True) (fun b => b = true → HasLiveOwner db now)
    (fun j => db.grants.val.length - j.val) ?_ i result trivial h
  intro j out _ hs
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop.body at hs
  i5h_invert hs
  all_goals simp_all only [role_implies_share, live_eq, ok.injEq, decide_eq_true_eq]
  all_goals first
    | (intro _; exact ⟨_, index_mem _ _ _ (by assumption), by assumption, by assumption⟩)
    | exact ⟨trivial, grant_progress db j _ (by assumption) (by assumption)⟩
    | simp

theorem folder_exists_owner (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64)
    (id : U64) (now : I64)
    (h : acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists db types ids .Share id now = ok true) :
    HasLiveOwner db now := by
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists at h
  i5h_invert h
  exact folder_owner db types ids _ now 0#usize true h rfl

theorem cascade_owner (db : model.Db) (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource) (now : I64)
    (h : acl.cascade_grant db s r .Share now = ok true) : HasLiveOwner db now := by
  cases r <;> unfold acl.cascade_grant at h <;> i5h_invert h
  all_goals try first
    | exact folder_exists_owner db _ _ _ now (by assumption)
    | exact direct_exists_owner db _ _ _ now (by assumption)
  rename_i id parent allowed hp ha ht
  rw [ht] at ha
  i5h_invert ha
  exact folder_exists_owner db _ _ _ now (by assumption)

theorem stronger_owner (best : Option model.Role) (role : model.Role)
    (h : acl.stronger best role = ok (some .Owner)) :
    best = some .Owner ∨ role = .Owner := by
  unfold acl.stronger at h
  i5h_invert h
  all_goals simp_all

theorem drive_loop_owner (db : model.Db) (drive : U64) (now : I64)
    (types : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (ids : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (best : Option model.Role) (i : Usize) (result : Option model.Role)
    (hinv : best = some .Owner → HasLiveOwner db now)
    (h : acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop db drive now types ids best i = ok result) :
    result = some .Owner → HasLiveOwner db now := by
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun state => state.1 = some .Owner → HasLiveOwner db now)
    (fun role => role = some .Owner → HasLiveOwner db now)
    (fun state => db.grants.val.length - state.2.val) ?_ (best, i) result hinv h
  rintro ⟨current, j⟩ out hx hs
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop.body at hs
  i5h_invert hs
  · rename_i hlt g hg matched hm next hn k hk
    refine ⟨?_, grant_progress db j k hlt hk⟩
    intro howner
    change next = some .Owner at howner
    rw [howner] at hn
    i5h_invert hn
    all_goals simp_all only [live_eq, ok.injEq]
    obtain hbest | hrole := stronger_owner current g.role hn
    · exact hx hbest
    · exact ⟨g, index_mem _ _ _ hg, hrole, by assumption⟩
  · exact hx

theorem drive_role_owner (db : model.Db) (s : model.Subject) (drive : U64)
    (now : I64) (role : Option model.Role)
    (h : acl.caller_role_on_drive db s drive now = ok role) :
    role = some .Owner → HasLiveOwner db now := by
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive at h
  i5h_invert h
  exact drive_loop_owner db drive now _ _ none 0#usize role (by simp) h

theorem role_has_share (role : Option model.Role)
    (h : acl.role_has role .Share = ok true) : role = some .Owner := by
  cases role with
  | none => simp [acl.role_has] at h
  | some value =>
    cases value <;> simp [acl.role_has, acl.role_grants,
      model.Permission.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqPermission.eq,
      model.Permission.read_discriminant] at h ⊢

theorem read_only_share : acl.read_only_gate_applies .Share = ok true := by
  simp [acl.read_only_gate_applies, core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default,
    core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.default,
    model.Permission.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqPermission.eq,
    model.Permission.read_discriminant]

theorem share_needs_owner (db : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource)
    (h : acl.check db ro now s .Share r = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now := by
  change HasLiveOwner db now
  unfold acl.check at h
  simp only [read_only_share, bind_ok, reduceIte] at h
  cases r <;> simp only [bind_ok, reduceIte] at h <;> i5h_invert h
  all_goals simp_all -failIfUnchanged only
  all_goals first
    | exact cascade_owner db s _ now (by assumption)
    | exact direct_exists_owner db _ _ _ now (by assumption)
    | exact drive_role_owner db s _ now _ (by assumption)
        (role_has_share _ (by assumption))

abbrev OwnerLive (db : model.Db) (now : I64) : Prop := ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now

theorem direct_loop (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (r : model.Resource) (now : I64)
    (i : Usize) (h : acl.direct_grant_exists_loop db types ids .Share r now i = ok true) : OwnerLive db now := by
  unfold acl.direct_grant_exists_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun _ => True) (fun b => b = true → OwnerLive db now) (fun j => db.grants.length - j.val)
    ?_ i true trivial h rfl
  intro j res _ hb
  unfold acl.direct_grant_exists_loop.body at hb
  i5h_invert hb
  all_goals dsimp only
  all_goals first
    | (refine ⟨trivial, incr_lt ?_ ‹_›⟩; scalar_tac)
    | (intro; exact ⟨_, index_mem ‹_›, role_implies_share ‹_› ‹_›, live_ok ‹_› ‹_›⟩)
    | simp


theorem folder_loop (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (now : I64) (target : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (i : Usize) (h : acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop db types ids .Share now target i = ok true) :
    OwnerLive db now := by
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun _ => True) (fun b => b = true → OwnerLive db now) (fun j => db.grants.length - j.val)
    ?_ i true trivial h rfl
  intro j res _ hb
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop.body at hb
  i5h_invert hb
  all_goals dsimp only
  all_goals first
    | (refine ⟨trivial, incr_lt ?_ ‹_›⟩; scalar_tac)
    | (intro; exact ⟨_, index_mem ‹_›, role_implies_share ‹_› ‹_›, live_ok ‹_› ‹_›⟩)
    | simp

theorem folder_exists (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (fid : U64) (now : I64)
    (h : acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists db types ids .Share fid now = ok true) : OwnerLive db now := by
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists at h
  i5h_invert h
  exact folder_loop _ _ _ _ _ _ h

theorem stronger_owner {a : Option model.Role} {b : model.Role}
    (h : acl.stronger a b = ok (some .Owner)) : a = some .Owner ∨ b = .Owner := by
  unfold acl.stronger at h
  i5h_invert h
  all_goals simp_all

theorem caller_loop (db : model.Db) (d : U64) (now : I64) (types : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (ids : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (best : Option model.Role) (i : Usize)
    (hb : best = some .Owner → OwnerLive db now)
    (h : acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop db d now types ids best i = ok (some .Owner)) : OwnerLive db now := by
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x => x.1 = some .Owner → OwnerLive db now) (fun o => o = some .Owner → OwnerLive db now)
    (fun x => db.grants.length - x.2.val) ?_ (best, i) _ hb h rfl
  rintro ⟨b0, j⟩ res hinv hs
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop.body at hs
  simp only [I5hLib.bind_ite] at hs
  i5h_invert hs
  all_goals dsimp only at hinv ⊢
  · rename_i hlt g hidx _ _ _ best1 hrest w hw
    refine ⟨?_, incr_lt (by scalar_tac) hw⟩
    obtain ⟨a, -, hx⟩ := hrest
    split at hx
    · obtain ⟨b2, hl, hx⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hx
      split at hx
      · intro ho; subst ho
        rcases stronger_owner hx with h' | h'
        · exact hinv h'
        · exact ⟨g, index_mem hidx, h', live_ok hl ‹_›⟩
      · simp at hx; subst hx; exact hinv
    · simp at hx; subst hx; exact hinv
  · rename_i best1 hb1 w hw
    subst hb1
    exact ⟨hinv, incr_lt (by scalar_tac) hw⟩
  · exact hinv

theorem role_has_share {o : Option model.Role} (h : acl.role_has o .Share = ok true) : o = some .Owner := by
  unfold acl.role_has at h
  split at h
  · simp at h
  · rename_i r
    cases r <;> simp_all [acl.role_grants, model.Permission.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqPermission.eq,
      model.Permission.read_discriminant]

theorem caller_owner (db : model.Db) (s : model.Subject) (d : U64) (now : I64) (o : Option model.Role)
    (h1 : acl.caller_role_on_drive db s d now = ok o) (h2 : acl.role_has o .Share = ok true) :
    OwnerLive db now := by
  have := role_has_share h2; subst this
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive at h1
  i5h_invert h1
  exact caller_loop _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (by simp) h1

theorem cascade_owner (db : model.Db) (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource) (now : I64)
    (h : acl.cascade_grant db s r .Share now = ok true) : OwnerLive db now := by
  unfold acl.cascade_grant at h
  i5h_invert h
  · rename_i w _
    obtain ⟨t, i⟩ := w
    exact folder_exists _ _ _ _ _ h
  · rename_i o _ b hb hbt
    subst hbt
    split at hb
    · simp at hb
    · i5h_invert hb
      rename_i w _
      obtain ⟨t, i⟩ := w
      exact folder_exists _ _ _ _ _ hb
  · rename_i w _
    obtain ⟨t, i⟩ := w
    exact direct_loop _ _ _ _ _ _ h

theorem direct_pair {db : model.Db} {r : model.Resource} {now : I64} (w : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (h : (let (types, ids) := w
      acl.direct_grant_exists db types.deref ids.deref .Share r now) = ok true) : OwnerLive db now := by
  obtain ⟨t, i⟩ := w
  exact direct_loop _ _ _ _ _ _ h

theorem caller_owner' {db : model.Db} {s : model.Subject} {d : U64} {now : I64} {o : Option model.Role}
    (h2 : acl.role_has o .Share = ok true) (h1 : acl.caller_role_on_drive db s d now = ok o) :
    OwnerLive db now := caller_owner db s d now o h1 h2

theorem share_needs_owner (db : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource)
    (h : acl.check db ro now s .Share r = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now := by
  unfold acl.check at h
  i5h_invert h
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals first
    | exact caller_owner' ‹_› ‹_›
    | exact cascade_owner _ _ _ _ ‹_›
    | exact direct_pair _ h

end oxicloud_kernel.Solution
